observations: Two stacked white plastic IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) tanks.
The tanks are secured by metal wire frames.
The top tank has a blue spigot and a white plastic filler cap.
The bottom tank has a white plastic filler cap.
The tanks show significant surface staining and discoloration, particularly on the sides and bottom.
The tanks are resting on a metal pallet.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI JACIN' are visible on all photos.

claims.evidence: The tanks are white plastic, but the reinforcement (steel ribs) is not clearly visible in the photos.

claims.claim: used only once for clean water
No crack, no leak, lids complete
claims.evidence: The photos show the lids and spigots, but there is no visual proof of the tank's structural integrity or the absence of leaks.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the welds and the underside of the tanks.
A video showing the tanks being filled and drained without leaks.
A photo of the technical data plate on the side of the tank.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical data plate on the side of the tank to confirm capacity and dimensions.
Photo of the welds and the underside of the tanks.
Video of the tanks being filled and drained to check for leaks.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
